messages:
anika: Quick thread for Cascade Systems assets. They sent a one-pager and a customer quote. Need logo lockups (horizontal + icon-only), hero banner (1600x600), marketplace tile (1024x512), and localized alt text in EN/FR/DE. Pref publish next Tue. Can we review for brand compliance and legal sign-off today? cc @thomas @rachel

thomas: Received. Uploading SVG/PNG exports to the Figma board: https://figma.com/cascade/redwood-cascade. Noticed partner's icon uses a gradient that disappears at smaller sizes. Recommend we request a flat-color fallback for small-format use.

brandbot: brandbot: Asset scan -> missing flat-color logo variant ❌; gradient present in SVGs ⚠; alt text missing for hero and marketplace tile ❌. See /checks/1945678901

oliver: Design: For the hero banner, 1600x600 @72dpi is fine. For the marketplace tile, keep <100KB. I'll export @1x and @2x. Also propose using our neutral grey background for co-branded assets to avoid contrast with Cascade teal.

rachel: Marketing: The one-pager has a customer quote but no release form. Cascade's CSM OK'd quote verbally. Legal needs a signed release. Also flagged an unsupported font in the PDF export (partner used Neutra Grotesk) 129; we need web-safe or outline the text.

mike: Sales: If publish hits next Tuesday, please coordinate with AMs by Monday COB. Also add a short playbook bullet list (3 bullets) for CROs.

anika: Actions: anika -> request flat-color logo + signed quote release; thomas -> add fallback variants and export sizes; oliver -> prepare marketplace tiles and suggested alt text (EN/FR/DE); rachel -> draft publish copy and placeholder attribution.

thomas: Uploaded suggested fallbacks: /figma/cascade/fallbacks. Added 1px light stroke option to the icon-only mark for dark backgrounds. Also left comments requesting original vector for the logotype (kerning odd at small sizes).

brandbot: brandbot: Accessibility check -> hero banner contrast pass ✅; marketplace tile contrast fail on dark variant ❌. Recommend light-stroke or white background.

rachel: Marketplace copy draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/cascade-marketplace. Draft uses conservative language: "up to 2.5x" reduction in batching cost (needs benchmarking link). If partner can't confirm numbers, we'll change to "meaningful reductions".

oliver: Alt text suggestions added in Figma notes: EN: "Redwood Inference and Cascade Systems logos with joint solution brief title"; FR: "Logos Redwood Inference et Cascade Systems avec titre du document"; DE: "Redwood Inference- und Cascade Systems-Logos mit Titel des gemeinsamen Dokuments". Placed assets in /assets/cascade/marketplace.

anika: Legal update: rachel send the redline to Cascade legal. I included a short release template: name + title + month/year required. Also removed a competitive comparison sentence from the one-pager.

mike: FYI for AMs: include link to enablement deck once final. Can someone add a one-slide summary for field?

thomas: I'll create a 1-slide AM summary in /figma/cascade/one-pager. Will include badges, link to marketplace, and a short tech note (supported models, latency note).

brandbot: brandbot: Thread status -> awaiting_partner_assets :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anika: If Cascade returns the signed release by EOD, we can ship assets Monday for QA and publish Tuesday morning. If not, push to next week. I'll post final links here when complete.

rachel: Thanks everyone. Quick ask: confirm we have usage rights for the customer logo in the one-pager. Cascade said yes but please confirm in the signed release.

mike: :thumbsup: will prep AM blurb once final assets are live.
